items.t: General Motors vs. Tesla: Which Is the Better Automotive Stock to Buy Going Into 2027?
items.sum: GM trades at 6.4x forward earnings while Tesla commands 236.8x, yet only one carries a debt-to-equity ratio near 2.1x. The gap raises a question about which risk investors are really paying for.

items.t: Can GM's Solar Projects Strengthen Manufacturing Cost Efficiency?
items.sum: General Motors is investing $550 million in two Michigan solar projects to secure predictable energy costs and advance its emissions reduction goals.

items.t: GM invests $550M into solar projects to offset factory emissions
items.sum: The Detroit automaker said the projects could produce enough hours of electricity annually to power all three Michigan assembly plants.

items.t: A $776 Car Payment Is a Warning for Ford and General Motors
items.sum: As the U.S. drives towards higher new car prices, it faces an affordability crisis leaving some consumers out of the market. This could be a problem for Ford and GM.

items.t: S&P revises GM outlook to positive on widening margins and cash flow
items.sum: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its credit outlook on General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) and subsidiary General Motors Financial Co. Inc. to positive from stable, citing significant margin recovery and expanding cash generation. S&P affirmed its 'BBB' issuer credit ratings on both entities, pointing to a potential upgrade over the next 12 to 24 months.
